capabilities: Build interactive graphs with saved layouts
Pin and arrange nodes using gravity centers
Filter, group, and style nodes and links
Export interactive HTML graphs with note previews
Automate graphs via API/MCP for AI agents
extras: MCP server is desktop-only, binds to 127.0.0.1, and requires connecting only trusted clients since they can export note content to their AI provider. Requires Obsidian 1.12.7+. iOS is unverified and touch box selection is unavailable on mobile. Deep reference material (physics model, full API/tool reference, troubleshooting) lives in external documentation.
intentEvidence: with its own rendering and physics engine, independent of the built-in Graph View
problem: Obsidian's built-in Graph View cannot save layouts, pin or arrange nodes, apply gravity centers, or export interactive graphs for sharing.

relations.evidence: independent of the built-in Graph View

summary: Interactive graph workspace with its own physics engine, saved layouts, gravity nodes, filters, HTML export, and an API/MCP server for AI agents.
